thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 12/27/2018: WATT, DCAR, JKS, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 12/27/2018: WATT, DCAR, JKS, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -1.52%
AAPL: -1.25%
IBM: -1.63%
CSCO: -0.92%
GOOG: -1.60%
Technology stocks were sinking in Thursday's pre-bell trading.
Stocks moving on news include:
(+) Energous ( WATT ), which was gaining more than 29% in value after it unveiled the first customer product to secure approval from the Federal Communications Commission: the WattUp-enabled personal sound amplification products from Delight.
(+) DropCar ( DCAR ) was jumping by more than 31% as it has completed the previously announced sale of its WPCS International - Suisun City unit, also known as its Suisun operations, for $3.5 million in cash.
(-) JinkoSolar Holding Company ( JKS ) was down more than 3% even after it was selected to supply solar modules for a 60-megawatt solar farm in Kampong Speu, Cambodia.
